target_customer: Actuarial teams at P&C carriers, reinsurers, MGAs, captives and actuarial consultancies
problem: Actuarial work such as data assembly, rating and reserving is slow and manual. Tesora agents do the assembly while actuaries keep the judgment calls.
business_model: B2B enterprise SaaS deployed single-tenant inside the customer stack, with hands-on forward-deployed onboarding
product_category: AI agents for actuarial and insurance pricing work

founders.name: Vivek Rao
education: University of Chicago Booth School of Business (alum, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Background taken from the YC company page.

founders.name: Federico Reyes Gomez
education: Stanford, BS and MS in computer science and philosophy (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he turned down a Stripe offer to join Kumo, a startup founded by his professor.

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents must read messy actuarial data, run pricing and reserving methods and deploy raters inside customer infrastructure with audit trails. The site cites SOC 2 Type II and single-tenant deployment, which adds engineering effort for a team of five.

defensibility.rationale: Deep deployment inside carrier stacks and audit trails could create switching costs, but general AI agent tooling and incumbent actuarial vendors can copy the approach. No proprietary data is claimed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established actuarial and pricing vendors were adding AI features by 2026 per trade coverage, but no source shows any of them buying or copying Tesora.

market_need_then: Insurers pay for actuarial pricing and reserving talent and software, and the work is repetitive assembly around judgment. Evidence here comes from the company's own pitch, not from independent spend data.

branding.domain_note: Uses tesora.ai. No source on how it was obtained. An older, unrelated company named Tesora (cloud database, acquired in 2017 per a tracker site) shares the name.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Professional and reassuring: stresses SOC 2, customer-controlled infrastructure and that the actuary makes every call

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand, no mascot or community found. Name is clean but shares a spelling with an older company and with similar names such as Tessera.

outcome_analysis: Tesora is active and early, a five person Summer 2025 YC team selling AI agents to actuaries. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff reporting exists. The company's site shows Foundation Capital and YC logos, but no funding amount or round is confirmed by any primary source, so its trajectory cannot yet be judged.
notes: Funding is unverified: StartupHub lists $10M, NeuronFeed lists $500K seed from Jan 2025, a job board says pre-seed. They conflict and none is primary, so no round is recorded. The $5.6M Huscarl seed and Tessera Labs rounds in search results belong to different companies. Competitors Huscarl and Hypercal surfaced only in 2026 coverage and are excluded as not dated near the batch. Foundation Capital logo on the site is not proof of a round.
